create_causal_mixin_model: create a vLLM causal language model using CausalMixin with VllmConfig and a HuggingFace transformers config
build_lm_head: build a ParallelLMHead layer for the causal model with vocab size, hidden size, and quantization config
compute_model_logits: compute logits from hidden states using CausalMixin compute_logits with the logits processor and lm_head
test_tie_word_embeddings: test CausalMixin with tied word embeddings to skip lm_head weight loading during checkpoint restoration
